Indicative rates from public market data; actual prices at jewellers and exchanges may differ.
Get a status-bar notification the moment any provider\'s AED→INR rate hits your target. Useful when you know what rate you\'d want before sending and don\'t want to keep re-checking the app.
Forgot what a feature does? Reset the welcome modal and it\'ll appear the next time you return to the home screen.

The mid-market (or \'interbank\') rate is the wholesale midpoint between the buy and sell prices in the global currency market. It is the most objective benchmark — every remittance provider charges some markup or fee on top.
We pull it from public financial-data sources, with automatic fallbacks if the primary is unavailable. The rate is refreshed alongside provider rates on the regular cycle.
Among the providers with verified live rates, the one giving you the most rupees per AED. Updated each refresh.
Each card also shows \'+0.02 vs mid-market\' or \'−0.05\' so you can see at a glance how each provider compares to the objective benchmark.
This app collects nothing. No analytics, no telemetry, no advertising, no account, no cloud sync.

Outbound network access is allowlisted at the application layer to a small set of public data hosts needed for rate updates. Anything else is blocked regardless of what any future dependency tries to do.

Permissions: INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE for the rate fetch. The optional POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission is requested once for daily-high alerts; you can deny or revoke it any time without breaking the app.

Rates shown are indicative and may differ at the provider. Confirm at the provider\'s app or website before sending money. Not financial advice. Not affiliated with any of the listed remittance providers. Provider names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners, used here for nominative identification in a comparison context only.
Status-bar alert when a provider beats today\'s previous best AED→INR rate. At most a few notifications per day.

A free, open-source comparison app for sending money from the UAE to India. No accounts, no ads, no analytics.
You can re-read this from the About screen any time.

Up to twelve UAE→India providers compared side-by-side: Wise, Aspora, Remitly, TransferGo, Al Ansari, Al Dahab, Ahalia, Federal, GCC, Index, Lari, LuLu. The provider giving you the most rupees gets a BEST badge.
The big number at the top is the wholesale interbank rate — every provider charges some markup over it. Each card shows the markup explicitly so the comparison is honest.
Tap the gold/silver card on home for live UAE and India rates — 24K + 22K gold, silver per gram and per kilogram, plus 30-day history.
The refresh button in the top bar pulls fresh rates on demand. The app already shows the last cron-published rates within a second; truly-fresh upstream rates land silently 30–45 seconds later.
A status-bar notification fires when a provider beats today\'s previous best AED→INR rate. Toggle off any time in About → Notifications. Permission is asked once on first launch.
Outbound network access is locked down at the application layer; no telemetry, no analytics, no third-party SDKs, no account.
